subject: Number of Rows and Columns of Table Proxy

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Number of Rows and Columns of Table Proxy
parts: I have created a data table proxy. How can I query the number of rows and columns of this, so that I can implement an action button to select all rows and columns ? selectRows and selectColumns have no special value for the selected parameter to represent all row or column indices.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Number of Rows and Columns of Table Proxy
parts:
Is there a reason that you don't know the number of rows/columns in
your data? i.e. why can't you do selectRows(proxy, selected =
seq_len(nrow(data)))?

Regards,

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: Number of Rows and Columns of Table Proxy
parts: The table could have rows added to it using addRow. I think that having a data.frame as a global variable in server.R and adding the newly created rows to it is a suitable solution. That would allow nrow to be used to query the number of records in the table. Perhaps that should be the suggested application design. It seems strange that table_cell_clicked also contains the cell data values. Separation of the data and its representation is a good design pattern.
